question.text: When a mica sheet of thickness 7 microns and $\mu=1.6$ is placed in the path of one of interfering beams in the biprism experiment then the central fringe gets at the position of seventh bright fringe. The wavelength of light used will be

solution.text:
$\lambda=\frac{(\mu-1) \mathrm{t}}{\mathrm{n}}$
According to question
$$
\mathrm{n}=7, \mu=1.6, \mathrm{t}=7 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{~meter}
$$
From eqs. (1) and $(2), \lambda=6 \times 10^{-7}$ meter
